text:
**用户：**
对对对，这个质感就有了！然后，我们用同样的方式，把光球的面板也这样改造。

**AI：**
<think>The user wants the orb panel itself to also have the same bold left border treatment. Let me find the panel's border style and add the left border overlay.</think>
<tool_TDds name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "grep -n 'border.*solid' /root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/orb.ts | head -10"}</param>
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
</tool_TDds><tool_result_1FAI name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"99:    border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3);\n140:          <div style=\"max-width:${innerWidth - 8}px;padding:6px 12px;background:${bgColor};border:1px solid ${borderColor};border-left:3px solid ${borderColor};border-radius:8px\">\n148:          <div style=\"max-width:85%;padding:6px 12px;background:${bgColor};border:1px solid ${borderColor};border-left:3px solid ${borderColor};border-radius:8px\">\n206:      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.2);","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_1FAI>
第99行是面板容器的边框。加上左侧加粗：
<tool_43g2 name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "sed -i 's/border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3);/border: 1px solid rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.3); border-left: 3px solid rgba(46, 213, 163, 0.6);/' /root/kfmv4/src/client/modules/orb.ts && cd /root/kfmv4 && node build.mjs 2>&1 && pkill -f 'node dist/server' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; nohup node dist/server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 0.5 && git add -A && git commit -m 'style: panel container add bold left border accent'"}</param>
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
</tool_43g2><tool_result_ZrNS name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"Build OK\n[detached HEAD 31b9eb0] style: panel container add bold left border accent\n 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_ZrNS>
commit: `31b9eb0`

面板容器：保留原有四面紫色细线，左侧叠加 3px 青绿色加粗边框——和光标高亮同款配色。

洛，刷新验证。
